root.description: The id of the root the path is under

config.description: The demanded config the compilation is of, relative to its root

path.description: The file holding the reference, relative to its root

ordinal.description: The reference's `ts_imports` ordinal in the file

kind.description: The module reference: `import` an ImportDeclaration; `export` an ExportDeclaration with a module specifier; `importEquals` `import x = require('m')`; `dynamic` `import(...)`; `importType` a type-position `import('m')`; `require` a call whose callee is the identifier `require`, by spelling; `createRequire` a call `createRequire(...)('m')` or a call through a name a variable declarator anywhere in the file binds to a `createRequire(...)` result (the bare name, a local name a top-level import from `module` or `node:module` binds, or `X.createRequire`); `ambient` `declare module 'm'`; `referencePath`, `referenceTypes`, `referenceLib` a `/// <reference path|types|lib>` directive; `jsdocImport` a JSDoc `@import` tag (`js` only); `jsdocImportType` a JSDoc `import('m')` type (`js` only)

specifier.description: The reference's specifier, as in `ts_imports`: never null, since TypeScript collects only a reference with a literal specifier

anyOf.description: What TypeScript's mode selection answered for the reference: `import` or `require`

mode.description: What TypeScript's mode selection answered for the reference (`import` or `require`), or null when it answered none

targetKind.description: `file`: resolved into git content, not through member mapping; `member`: resolved through the member mapping into a workspace member, after the output map; `memberUndeclared`: a bare specifier naming a workspace member that neither the file's owning manifest nor a workspace manifest above it declares, so no link exists; `external`: a bare specifier that is no workspace member and that no `paths` key matches: third-party code lives in `node_modules`, never git content, so only its name is known; `builtin`: unresolved, and `node:`-prefixed or a builtin per the running Node's isBuiltin; `lib`: a `referenceLib` directive; TypeScript's bundled library files are not git content; `outputUnmapped`: resolved to a path under an emitting config's output directories that no demanded config's output map holds, such as a bundler's output; `unresolved`: resolution failed for a relative, absolute, `#` or `paths`-matched specifier, or for a member mapping

target.description: The resolved file, relative to its root, or null when the outcome names no git-content file

package.description: As in `ts_imports`: set for every bare specifier, whatever the resolution

pathsMatched.description: Whether a `paths` key of the config matches the specifier by TypeScript's own matcher

redirected.description: Whether the output map turned a resolved output path into its source

projection-ts-import-targets.description: A row of the derived `ts_import_targets` relation: what TypeScript resolves a reference to under a demanded config, not a runtime claim
